title: Softee Geometry Protector - Protectors
description:
SOFTEE GEOMETRY PROTECTOR - New model of Softee protector, of the highest quality, with a rough touch and a modern design. SOFTEE GEOMETRY PROTECTOR, one of the best protectors for our padel rackets that we can see in the catalog. This model has quality manufacturing, meticulously cared for to ensure the resistance of the frame to possible knocks and scratches. We will ensure that our frame does not rub against the ground or the glass and thus the racket does not suffer damage.

Available in different colors, such as red, blue, silver or gold, choose the one you like before they are sold out.
